title: vivo has launched its new foldable phone, the X Fold 6, in India, following its debut in China earlier this year. The phone opens to reveal a huge inner display of almost eight inches, with a 120 Hz refresh rate for smoother motion. It runs on a powerful new processor, with 12 GB of memory and 512 GB of storage, and a 200 MP main camera that can shoot 8K video. The battery is 6,900 mAh with 80 W fast charging. In short: a phone that turns into a small tablet in your pocket. Do you prefer foldable phones or regular phones? 📱
